notes.title: Knights of Braveland is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4f9ee6c61bd6d6b93e22359b9e91571774277e99.png[/img]

[h1]Knights of Braveland is available now![/h1]

Heroes Guild awaits you. Only you can defeat all the infamous villains threatening the kingdom.

Knights of Braveland is a cooperative beat'em up action game with a generated story. Join the Heroes Guild and travel the path from a rookie to the hero of the kingdom. Head on a hunt for the vicious boss solo or with your friends. Your adventure will be randomly generated from hundreds of different events.

You will hack, slash, and smash your way to victory. And with your friends it is much more fun. Play local or online.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253610/Knights_of_Braveland/

[h2]Keep up with the latest news[/h2]
We share updates on several different platforms. To hear about every tidbit as soon the info drops, you should join our other communities!

[url=http://www.tortugateam.com/joindiscord]Discord[/url] - [url=https://twitter.com/TortugaTeam]Twitter[/url] - [url=https://www.tortugateam.com/knights/email/]Newsletter[/url]

notes.title: Check out Spaceland - Out Now
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

Today we would like to share some exciting news with you: our new story based strategy Spaceland has been released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10135204/2dbd72780049d4f61d67ab898351b945a33e669d.gif[/img]

Spaceland is an incredibly dynamic turn-based strategy, reviving the traditions of XCOM, Incubation and Laser Squad. Lead a team of the most desperate fighters, destroy alien monsters and uncover the secrets of the lost planet.

[previewyoutube=myAlbM8H2uc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Top Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game is inspired by the best turn-based strategies of the old school - XCOM, Incubation, Laser Squad
[*] A unique blend of dynamic turn-based battles lasting 10-15 minutes
[*] Make a squad from 7 space rangers, each with a unique fighting style
[*] The story of the mysterious planet in the spirit of the «golden age» of science fiction
[/list]

Support our new game with story in Braveland style and start the space adventure!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021070/Spaceland/

notes.title: Maelstrom, Braveland Pirate & Shadowhand join the Pirate bundle!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10135204/fbdb6b01d96ca491f9bff66930ed8ca4b77c14eb.jpg[/img]

Ahoy, captain! We’ve got some great news for you since our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7594/Pirate_AAAAR_Bundle/]Pirate ‘AAAAR!’ bundle[/url] has been updated with two more incredible titles that will expand your virtual buccaneering experience like never before!

Whether it is fast-paced swordplay with thrilling sea battles or tactical strategy game — don’t worry, we've got you covered. By purchasing this bundle you will be able to fulfill your thirst for all of the privateer-related activities you wish could be done in real life* and many more! 

*But seriously, don’t.


The bundle contains the following games:
[list]
[*] Tempest
[*] Windward
[*] Sid Meier's Pirates!
[*] Maelstrom
[*] Braveland Pirate
[*] Shadowhand
[/list]


And remember - if you already own any of the titles above, buying the Pirate ‘AAAAR!’ bundle saves you money on the rest of those wonderful games!

See you soon! [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11019625/d6a6dfd4275d45519cc6f099fbbb48daa51024b0.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Update: Fast Battle Mode
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10135204/7bd76aff508495209e2451fc377ac20ef49d4953.png[/img]

Hi, Bravelanders!

[h1]Fast animations mode[/h1]
We've added fast battle mode that speeds up all animations! So you can play the game at your own pace. We've tested new mode and it's gorgeous. Almost faster than light. :)

[h1]Grind issues in Braveland Wizard fixed[/h1]
This week we've fixed grind issues in Braveland Wizard. Hurray! No more repetitive battles. Dungeons give you more gold to hire new troops. Start of the game is easier. That fixes affects all three difficulties so you can try it and say us is it ok or not.

In case you forgot what Braveland Wizard is:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/333880/Braveland_Wizard/

Thanks for reading this post to the end. Have a nice day!
